title: Zakarpattia
summary: Zakarpattia refers to various entities associated with the region of Zakarpattia Oblast [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]], including its administrative structure, historical context, and cultural significance.

sections.heading: Zakarpattia Oblast
paragraphs: [[zakarpattia-oblast|Zakarpattia Oblast]] is an administrative region located on the inner side of the [[carpathians|Carpathians]] in [[modern-history-of-ukraine|modern Ukraine]].
The Zakarpattia Oblast Council serves as the regional assembly governing this oblast.

sections.heading: Administrative Divisions
paragraphs: The administrative divisions of Zakarpattia Oblast consist of sub-regional units that facilitate local governance within the region.

sections.heading: Referendums and Elections
paragraphs: The 1991 [[transcarpathia|Zakarpattia]] general regional referendum was a significant event in Zakarpattia Oblast, reflecting the region's political landscape.
Regional elections for the Council of Zakarpattia Oblast took place in 2006 and again in 2010, highlighting the ongoing democratic processes in the region.

sections.heading: Historical Context
paragraphs: Historically, Zakarpattia refers to a wider area on the inner side of the Carpathian Mountains, centered around modern Zakarpattia Oblast, and has been known by various terms in English.
The region experienced significant political changes during the transitional post-war period from 1918 to 1919, and was part of the First Czechoslovak Republic from 1919 to 1938.
From 1938 to 1939, Zakarpattia was included in the Second Czechoslovak Republic, followed by annexation by Hungary from 1939 to 1945.

sections.heading: Cultural and Sports Associations
paragraphs: The Zakarpattia Regional Committee of the Communist Party of [[ukraine|Ukraine]] was established de facto in 1944 and de jure in 1946, influencing the region's political framework.
FC Zakarpattia [[uzhhorod|Uzhhorod]], now known as FC [[hoverla|Hoverla]] Uzhhorod, is a football club that represents the region, alongside its second-league team, FC Zakarpattia-2 Uzhhorod.

sections.heading: Geography
paragraphs: The Zakarpattia Lowland is a geographical feature located in the southwestern parts of Zakarpattia Oblast, contributing to the region's diverse landscape.
